# DZ Muay Thai, by Dennys Dzalaby

> Private Muay Thai, MMA and self-defence lessons in Torre del Mar (Málaga, Spain), with travel to Vélez-Málaga, Nerja, Rincón de la Victoria, Málaga and the Axarquía. A private lesson for one, or bring your partner, friends or family; for groups of any size, write for a price.

- Coach: Dennys Dzalaby, Muay Thai and MMA coach based in Torre del Mar.
- Private lesson: €30 per person, 60 minutes.
- Gloves, pads and shin guards included; you pay at the end, in cash or Bizum.
- 10-lesson pack: €270, no expiry.
- Training for two: €45 per session for both (€22.50 each). Groups of 3 or more: price on request.
- Beginners welcome: no experience or fitness needed to start.
- Where: based in Torre del Mar; sessions on the beach, at your home or in a park near you, in the service areas. The exact spot is agreed when you book.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 07:00–21:00, Sunday 07:00–15:00.
- The website is in Spanish (/) and English (/en/).
- Booking: by WhatsApp or the form on the site.
